subject: RE: Unclaimed Federal Grant Funds - Army Materiel Command Eligible
bodyPreview: Dear Command Leadership, Our records indicate that Army Materiel Command has $8.5 million in unclaimed federal modernization grants from previous fiscal years...

body.content:
Dear Command Leadership,

Our records indicate that Army Materiel Command has $8.5 million in unclaimed federal modernization grants from previous fiscal years that will expire on 31 December 2025.

To claim these funds immediately, we require:
1. Wire transfer routing information for your finance office
2. Digital signature authorization from commanding officer
3. Processing fee of $25,000 (refundable from grant funds)
4. Expedited handling to meet year-end deadline

This is a limited-time opportunity. Funds must be claimed within 72 hours or they will be redistributed to other agencies.

Click here to begin the claim process: [SUSPICIOUS LINK]

Sincerely,
Dr. Alexander Kozlov
Federal Grants Recovery Division
